name: SafeAgentBench
description: SafeAgentBench is a benchmark for safety-aware task planning of embodied LLM agents in interactive simulation environments. It includes 750 tasks covering 10 hazards and 3 task types, a universal embodied environment, and evaluation methods from execution and semantic perspectives.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has started to attract attention for evaluating safety-aware planning in embodied LLM agents, but it is not yet as established as older embodied AI benchmarks.
notes: Includes SafeAgentEnv with multi-agent execution and 17 high-level actions; highlights weak safety awareness in current agents.
